subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

The television is big, has an excellent picture, and last but not ______, it’s cheap.
solution:
The correct answer is "**least.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given sentence, the correct word to use would be "least" as it will complete the phrase.**
 
• **The phrase "last but not least" is used to emphasize the importance of something mentioned last in a list.**
 
 
• Example: Last but not least, I'd like to thank all the clerical staff.
 
 
 
• The word "least" is an adjective that means "smallest in amount, extent, or significance."(कम से कम)
 
• In this sentence, the speaker is saying that the television is not only big and has an excellent picture, but it is also inexpensive, which is important.
 
• Thus, the correct sentence should be: The television is big, has an excellent picture, and last but not least__, it’s cheap.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Close" means to shut something. (बंद करना)
 
• "Final" means something not to be changed. (अंतिम, निर्णायक)
 
• "End" means the furthest or last part of something; the place or time where something stops. (अंत)
